description: MVP instrument universe (iap.mvp): one synthetic large-cap equity, SYN.EQ.AAPL, listed on XV1/XV2/XV3. instrument_id 12 is the next free equity id (the bundled universe uses 1..11 for equities/ETF and 101..108 for FX) so the MVP never shadows a bundled instrument. Same schema as configs/instruments/instruments.json: tick_size real price per tick, lot_size shares per board lot, adv in shares/day, ref_price the generator's starting efficient price. The trading session (open/close, timezone) is NOT here: it is the mvp.json session block, which iap.mvp.feed composes into the reference-data document so the session length has exactly one source of truth.

calendar.description: Single synthetic trading day of the MVP session.
